text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing. Tosen Jordan handed me 
her smartphone. On the screen, a certain 
traditional inn was displayed...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the ryokan on that website amazing?! 
I wanna go! Actually, I'm definitely 
going!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They said just getting food is fine too, 
and that it's super tasty! Come on, let's 
head over right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, the place seems to be quite far 
away. I told them we should reschedule and 
go when we have more time to spare... 
but."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, take the train and you're there in a 
flash! Besides, going right when you feel 
like it is the golden rule, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding the train to the inn, an attendant 
welcomed us at the entrance. When we 
mentioned we had come to eat—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, you're gonna clean and fillet the 
fish we caught?!

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, this is our main feature. The chef 
prepares the guest's fish right before 
their eyes. How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~ I wanna do it, I wanna do it! I'm 
definitely gonna do it~!!
choice_data_list: Still, we're short on time today...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why wouldn't I do it after coming 
this far?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Being good at it is obviously better! 
There's no choice but to go for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by her momentum, we ended up 
fishing in the sea near the inn, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey! Trainer again!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Why is it that you're the only one 
catching anything this whole time?!
choice_data_list:
Then we caught something, so let's head 
back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way I'm going back! Like hell I'm 
gonna let it end like this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I definitely won't lose... I'm gonna go 
even deeper!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Shut up, I know—... Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry, for real. Dropping you... 
into the ocean...
choice_data_list: I'm fine, I just got a little wet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way am I fine! ...Wait, seriously, 
this is bad. You might catch a cold, so we 
gotta dry you off quick...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Um, I borrowed yukata, towels, and a 
hairdryer... so, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan silently dried my hair using 
a towel and a hairdryer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't the wind kinda hot?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hey, so. The innkeeper said the 
bath's ready. Why don't you go ahead?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm... well, I just take it easy, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she pretends to be composed, it's 
clear that she's deeply dejected. How 
should I comfort her...?
choice_data_list: ...Have you reflected on what you did?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she pretends to be composed, it's 
clear that she's deeply dejected. How 
should I comfort her...?
choice_data_list: ...Have you reflected on what you did?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...? I'm glad... you say...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No, this is where you're supposed to get 
mad...! I totally dragged you all over the 
place."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gorging on food, dragging you around, 
collapsing from exhaustion... ...making 
you protect me, falling into the sea...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how you look at it, this is 
pissing me off. All of this.
choice_data_list:
I think it's great that you're so 
energetic.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"That's why it's such a mess, isn't it?! 
We're being swung all over the place!"
choice_data_list: It's fun precisely because it's hard work.

It's fun precisely because it's hard work, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...Are you an idiot? Seriously."

Contrary to her words, Tosen Jordan seemed 
somewhat pleased.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Of course I would. Obviously. Things 
have gotten totally out of hand, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"At times like this, only writing a letter 
of apology comes to mind, but... want to 
write one? "
choice_data_list:
Forget the written apology, just don't go 
catching a cold, got it?

Forget about the written apology, just 
make sure you don't catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah? What's that about? Are you still 
worrying about me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Seriously... Just how softhearted are you?

Afterward, Tosen Jordan grew quiet, 
seemingly lost in thought.
